Results.ReviewText:
I ordered this online from Home Depot. Home Depot is great! Fast delivery. However: THIS PRODUCT IS TERRIBLE! Upon delivery, I couldn’t assemble it properly due to terrible instructions included that actually show a part THAT DOES NOT EVEN EXIST and if it did would make the unit unusable! I had to go on YouTube for an assembly video. Upon completion, it ran for about ten minutes and the trimmer line broke TWICE while trimming just grass! I am familiar with trimmers, avoid hitting the fence and other objects, and I have used them for many years. I’m not a rookie! Respooling the line was not too difficult but two line failures in ten minutes is not acceptable! The vibrations are excessive! So excessive that the spring loaded pin that positions the lower shaft into the upper shaft is shaken out of its position causing the trimmer head to rotate clockwise out of position despite the hand screw designed to hold the shaft in position (along with the spring loaded pin) being tightened very tight. After several re-assemblies of the lower shaft for this issue, I called Wild Badger customer support and was asked to re-assemble it again for the agent. It failed again. I had to send pictures and was told that a new unit would be sent. It never arrived. The new unit was actually delivered to a different state and different address according to the tracking information. Wild Badger says that the unit is not returnable to them or to Home Depot! Not true! After the new unit did not arrive, a call to Home Depot appeared to solve the issue. They said to drain the gasoline and return it to the store and they would send a new unit with a courtesy discount. Like I said, Home Depot is great!!! The new unit arrived, was assembled, started easily, and worked FOR LESS THAN TEN MINUTES before the same issues started again. Thinking I may have done something wrong, I watched a different YouTube assembly video and re-assembled the unit. (I actually hadn’t done anything incorrectly with the assembly of either unit!) Upon starting it again, the same line break and head rotation occurred. JUST DON’T BUY THIS MACHINE! 
I will be returning this unit to Home Depot today and selecting a different brand.
Results.Title: DO NOT PURCHASE!

Results.ReviewText:
I recently bought my first gas-powered lawn trimmer after being disappointed with an electric model I had before. The electric one just didn't have enough power for my needs, and constantly having to recharge the battery made yard work take much longer than it should. This new 52cc gas trimmer has been a good addition for me.  
What I really love about it is how well-balanced the weight is - it feels comfortable to use and doesn't strain my arms like some other trimmers I've tried. While I'd heard good things about this brand before, this is my first time actually buying one of their products. I'm hopeful it will last me for years to come. The power difference compared to my old electric trimmer is night and day. It cuts through thick grass and weeds effortlessly.  
So far, I'm really pleased with my purchase. Not having to stop and recharge batteries has made my yard work so much more efficient. While I know gas equipment requires more maintenance, the trade-off in power and convenience seems worth it. This trimmer has made quick work of areas that used to be a struggle with my electric model. Fingers crossed it continues to perform this well over time!

Results.ReviewText: Harness should accommodate a 6'2" 300 lb man comfortably but is very constrictive. It started well and idled well but when the throttle was pulled the motor acted as if it was under a heavy load. Think driving away with the parking brake engaged. I thought it was normal so I trimmed the grass around my house. I found when I released the throttle the trimmer head stopped in about 1-2 seconds from full throttle. I thought WIERD. I then started to smell a hot brake like smell. I put the unit on the porch to investigate and found there was light smoke rising from the motor covering. Upon smelling it, the smell reminded me of hot brake pads. Remember the above statement about driving with the parking brake on? I put it in the garage and then I sent an inquiry to their customer service email and as of 3 days later no reply from them. This must have an internal engine brake of some sort that is adjusted/installed wrong. I'm bringing it back to Home Depot. A brand new unit should work correctly out of the box.

311424784.Description: The Wild Badger Power 2-in-1 Straight Shaft Grass String Trimmer and Brush Cutter is a versatile, powerful tool. This multi-tool has a grass trimmer spool for detail work along fence lines and borders, as well as a brush cutter blade to tackle heavier grasses and thick brush. It also includes a harness coupled with ergonomic bicycle-style handles to relieve the strain on your arms and provide stability. Powered by a 52cc, 2-cycle, full-crank engine, your trimmer has plenty of power and is designed for reliability. The full crank design provides a smooth start and operation to reduce emissions, increase fuel efficiency and provide longer life. The transmission is supported by an aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube which is lightweight and durable for added comfort and convenience. The tap-and-go trimmer head allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawns and landscaping looking clean. Notes about the product: This machine takes a mix of both gasoline and oil, other attachments and accessories not included.
